create_toxicity_list: create a ToxicityList instance from word list file paths for toxicity detection
tokenize_text_for_toxicity: tokenize text using ToxicityList._tokenize to prepare it for toxicity matching
count_toxic_words: count the number of unique toxic words in text using toxicity_count method
extract_toxic_words: extract all toxic words found in text using the get_toxic_words method
init_with_sentencepiece: initialize ToxicityList with a SentencePiece model path for subword tokenization
